GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.desc: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.de: A Gu card must be used with an Activation card in hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.d: The listed amount is shared among all living enemies.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.des: If the target dies, remaining hits move to another enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_PO_SHI.desc: Triggers when this effect reduces an enemy's existing Block to 0.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XU_YING.des: Automatically Retained and cannot be played manually. After a non-Phantom Attack resolves, manifests at the listed chance. Phantoms do not trigger other Phantoms.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_LI.des: Beast Gu begin combat sealed. Each first effective resolution of the matching Companion advances the first sealed Gu of that type by 1. At 3, it immediately unseals and joins the Gu draw sequence. Progress lasts only for this combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_NIAN_HUA.de: Time Path resource. At 6, trigger Yearful and reset to 0; excess Years continue resolving.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SUI_MAN.des: Choose 1 Gu in cooldown and shorten its cooldown by 1 turn; extend all timed enemy debuffs by 1 turn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_HUAN_BU.des: Slow Step X reduces the enemy's total damage for each attack action by X; multi-hit attacks share the amount. Duration is shown on the card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XI_YING.des: A temporary normal-card copy created by Backtrack. It Exhausts and cannot be copied by Backtrack again; playing it grants Years as shown on Backtrack Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI1.d: Consume up to 1 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI2.d: Consume up to 2 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI3.d: Consume up to 3 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_QI_CORE: An ordinary Blood Parasite triggers as I, II, then III when its host is actively played, and hatches after III. Attacks deal damage and Bleed; Skills gain Block and draw 1 on hatch.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_YUE_COR: A Blood Moon Parasite has no stages. After its host is actively played, choose another ordinary Blood Parasite to trigger and advance immediately.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHANG_SHI.d: Based on current HP: 75% or less is Light Injury, 50% or less Heavy Injury, and 25% or less Critical Injury.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHE_GUANG_C: Trigger Refraction when your previously actively played Attack, Skill, or Power has a different type from this Light-path card. Forced Refraction ignores this condition; replays do not retrigger it.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_JU_GUANG_CO: The next card to trigger Refraction consumes 1 stack and resolves its Refraction effect 1 additional time.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_TIAO_GU_COR: Move one eligible regular Gu from the Gu Hand to the tail of Gu Storage, then refill from the current head.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YUE_HUA_COR: Since Golden Moon Gu's last activation, each true Refraction grants 1 Moonlight. There is no limit.
